name: Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years
original_name: 機動戦艦ナデシコ The blank of 3years
source: A follow up to the Kidou Senkan Nadesico anime, this game covers the events that occur in the storyline between the end of the series and the movie.
translation: 本作是动画《机动战舰抚子号》的后续故事，讲述电视动画结局至剧场版之间发生的事件。
